battle.name: 拜占庭—薩珊戰爭 (602年—628年)
battle.theater: 美索不達米亞與安納托利亞
battle.brief: 602年霍斯勞二世藉口為莫里斯復仇開戰，廿六年間連取達拉、安提阿與耶路撒冷，邊防退到博斯普魯斯海峽。希拉克略即位後放棄死守，627年12月12日在尼尼微濃霧中佯退反擊，翌年逼出薩珊政變，630年和約收回失地並迎回真十字架。卡面月牙劍早此戰一千五百餘年，是外彎單刃刀劍的源頭。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 交戰的兩方是拜占庭（羅馬）帝國與薩珊波斯帝國，戰線自幼發拉底河一路拉到博斯普魯斯海峽與高加索。拜占庭方面以帝國東部的邊防體系為骨架：卡帕多細亞、亞美尼亞、小亞美尼亞與色雷斯各軍區的兵員分守要道，邊城如達拉、埃德薩、安條克各有守軍與民兵，君士坦丁堡則有禁衛軍、直屬部隊與一支地中海艦隊。610年希拉克略在非洲起兵，靠的是總督轄下的海軍與埃及的船隊，亞美尼亞的瓦漢在高原上牽制波斯兵力，阿拉伯盟友加薩尼人控制南部沙漠，626年最後守城時可用者約一萬二千名精騎與數十艘戰船。薩珊方面由 spahbadh（軍團長）分掌王家軍，騎兵編為四個軍團，另有重騎、步兵、工兵與象房，御前會議與樞密院掌握調兵，邊疆總督負責地方守備與徵發；其盟友有阿瓦爾人與斯拉夫人、伊比利亞與高加索諸部，611年起巴勒斯坦的猶太起義者亦站在波斯一方。拜占庭的首都在最西端，薩珊的首都在中部的泰西封，因此這不是兩軍在單一戰場對撞，而是整條邊疆同時被拉開，二十六年間兩國的每一段國界都在作戰。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Byzantine (Roman) Empire and the Sasanian Empire, and the front ran from the Euphrates all the way to the Bosporus strait and the Caucasus. On the Byzantine side the skeleton of the army was the defensive system of the eastern provinces: troops from the themes of Cappadocia, Armenia, the Anatolikon and Thrace guarded the roads, frontier towns such as Dara, Edessa and Antioch had their own garrisons and local militias, while Constantinople had the Excubitores, the imperial household troops and a Mediterranean fleet. When Heraclius rose in Africa in 610 he relied on the admiral's seamen and the ships of Egypt; Vahan and the Armenian highlanders tied down Persian strength in the mountains, the Arab Ghassanid allies covered the southern desert, and at the last stand in 626 the defenders counted about 12,000 trained cavalry and a few dozen warships. On the Sasanian side the royal army was divided among the spahbadhs, the generals, with the cavalry formed into four divisions, alongside the heavy cavalry, the infantry, the engineers and the elephant corps; the royal council and the central bureaucracy handled troop movements, and the frontier governors handled local defence and supply. Their allies included the Avars and Slavs, the peoples of Iberia and the Caucasus, and from 611 the Jewish insurgents of Palestine fought on the Persian side. The Byzantine capital lay at the far western end and the Sasanian capital at Ctesiphon in the middle, so this was never a clash of two armies on one battlefield: the entire frontier was pulled open, and for twenty-six years every stretch of both borders was at war.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的有薩珊王霍斯勞二世、拜占庭皇帝福卡斯與希拉克略，以及在東西兩線作戰的一批將領。霍斯勞二世以「為朋友與岳父復仇」為名開戰，卻把 591 年與莫里斯訂下的和約撕掉，晚年又以沙赫巴拉茲、沙欣兩員大將的進攻掩蓋朝堂的猜忌。602 年推翻莫里斯的福卡斯是名義上的挑釁者：他殺死莫里斯五個兒子中的四個，603 年把叛將納爾西斯燒死在柱上，卻在 610 年被希拉克略推翻處死，臨死前還與繼任者有過一段著名的對答。希拉克略才是扭轉局面的人：610 年以三十五歲之齡從迦太基登船，622 年起放棄死守邊防，改在亞美尼亞與高加索之間進行季節性遠征，627 年 12 月 12 日在尼尼微以佯退拖住波斯主力，628 年 1 月 6 日發出最後通牒，逼出宮廷政變，630 年迎回真十字架。亞美尼亞馬米科尼昂家族的瓦漢在 603 年之後拖住波斯在安納托利亞的後方，功勞不在話下。波斯方面的沙赫巴拉茲 614 年攻陷耶路撒冷、626 年圍困卡爾刻冬，628 年倒戈後被自己人刺殺；沙欣打到卡爾刻冬，626 年在呂庫斯河戰敗後抑鬱而終；追擊希拉克略的亞美尼亞裔將領拉赫扎德則於 627 年陣亡於尼尼微。卡瓦德二世 628 年弒父即位後立刻求和，牧首塞爾吉烏斯主持了 626 年的守城與遊行，尼基福羅斯牧首留下了《簡史》這部戰爭的主要見證。
peopleEn: Those who decided the shape of this war were the Sasanian king Khosrow II, the Byzantine emperors Phocas and Heraclius, and a set of generals fighting on both fronts. Khosrow II went to war under the pretext of avenging his friend and father-in-law, yet he tore up the treaty of 591 concluded with Maurice, and in his last years he covered the intrigues of his court with the offensives of two great generals, Shahrbaraz and Shahin. Phocas, who overthrew Maurice in 602, was the nominal aggressor: he killed four of Maurice's five sons and in 603 had the rebel Narses burned at the stake, only to be overthrown and executed by Heraclius in 610, exchanging a famous remark with his successor even as he died. Heraclius was the man who turned the war: in 610 he boarded his ship at Carthage at the age of thirty-five, and from 622 he gave up holding the frontier and instead ran seasonal campaigns between Armenia and the Caucasus; on 12 December 627 he checked the main Persian force at Nineveh by a feigned retreat, on 6 January 628 he issued his ultimatum and forced a palace coup, and in 630 he brought the True Cross home. Vahan of the Mamikonian house in Armenia tied down Persia's rear in Anatolia from 603 onward, and his share of the work is not small. Shahrbaraz took Jerusalem in 614 and ringed Chalcedon in 626, was turned in 628 and then stabbed by his own men; Shahin reached Chalcedon and died of the despair that followed his defeat on the Lycus in 626; Rhahzadh, the Armenian-born Persian general who tracked Heraclius, fell at Nineveh in 627. Kavad II, who killed his father in 628, sued for peace at once, Patriarch Sergius directed the defence of the city and the processions of 626, and Patriarch Nikephoros left the Brief History, the principal witness to the war.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍（khopesh）是青銅時代的外彎單刃鉤形劍，約公元前1500年已在埃及定型：刀身彎向前，刃口走外弧，握柄為直柄套筒，重心偏前，砍擊以切割為主，也能用彎鉤勾住敵方盾牌、扯住騎士的手臂或繩索把人拽下馬；它出土於埃及新王國的武器庫，也見於特洛伊第二層的遺物，而在希臘與近東，學界另有一派看法認為直線化的 kopis 一系即由它衍出。要說它在 602 至 628 年戰役中的位置，必須老實講：戰場上沒有真正的月牙劍，它早於此戰一千五百餘年；它的意義是「單刃、外彎、以砍與勾為功能」這一武器譜系的源頭，而兩軍的近身刀劍都出自這條血統。薩珊騎兵配的是長身單刃彎刀與短單刃直劍（akakia），拜占庭的長劍是帕拉梅里翁、短劍是斯帕提翁，銅器時代的鉤形刀在這一千五百年間被鍛成了鐵與鋼的版本。戰場上真正大量消耗的是長兵與弓箭：薩珊重騎用約兩公尺四、菱形鐵矛頭的孔托斯長槍，配鱗甲胸甲、小圓盾與馬甲；薩珊弓騎用反曲複合弓與箭壺，箭雨在尼尼微之戰的濃霧中成為關鍵變數；拜占庭的精騎（Optimatoi）以標槍與長劍作近戰突擊，步軍則是持長圓盾的盾牌兵，著鎖子甲。攻城一方用配重式投石機、雲梯、攻城塔與掘地道的工兵，626 年圍君士坦丁堡時拜占庭的水師用火油瓶與手搖火船在金角灣內攻擊敵船，627 至 628 年圍第比利斯時拜占庭還動用了已知最早的繃索式投石機之一。運輸靠馬匹、駱駝與帆船，埃及失守之後首都失去了最重要的穀物產區。
kitsEn: The khopesh on the card is a bronze-age forward-curved single-edged sickle sword, a type already fixed in Egypt by about 1500 BC: the blade curves forward, the edge runs along the outer arc, the grip is a straight socketed hilt, the point of balance sits forward, and it cuts on the stroke while the hook can catch a shield, seize the arm of a horseman or pull down a man by his rope. It has been excavated from the arsenals of the New Kingdom in Egypt and appears among the finds of Troy II, and in Greece and the Near East one school of thought holds that the straightened kopis line descends from it. Its place in a campaign of 602 to 628 must be stated honestly: no real khopesh was on the field, for it predates this war by some fifteen centuries; what it represents is the fountainhead of the family of single-edged outward-curved weapons built for cutting and hooking, and the close-combat blades of both armies descend from that line. The Sasanian horseman carried a long single-edged curved sword and a short single-edged straight blade, the akakia; the Byzantine long sword was the paramerion and the short one the spathion, and the copper sickle knife of the bronze age had by this point been reforged in iron and steel. What was consumed in bulk on the field was the lance and the bow: the Sasanian heavy cavalry used a kontos about 2.4 metres long with a leaf-shaped iron head, wearing scale cuirasses, small round shields and horse barding; the Sasanian mounted archers used the composite reflex bow and the gorytos, and the volley of arrows became the decisive variable in the fog at Nineveh; the Byzantine elite, the Optimatoi, struck with javelins and swords in close combat, while the foot were skoutatoi with long oval shields and mail. The besiegers used counterweight trebuchets, ladders, siege towers and sappers with mines; in 626 the Byzantine fleet fought the enemy in the Golden Horn with fire-pots and hand-driven fire ships, and in 627 to 628 the Byzantines at Tbilisi employed one of the earliest known traction trebuchets. Supply and movement depended on horses, camels and sailing ships, and once Egypt was lost the capital had given up the most important grain-producing region it had.
tactics: 薩珊的打法是典型的邊疆戰爭模式：沿幼發拉底河東岸與亞美尼亞高原兩路推進，騎兵先用反曲弓的箭雨覆蓋，再由重騎帶長槍衝鋒；同時不求一次會戰決勝，而是逐點吃掉羅馬的邊城，切斷各城之間的聯絡，達拉、埃德薩、阿米達、安提阿、耶路撒冷都是這樣陷落的。圍城時用配重投石機與築壘逼近，614 年耶路撒冷被攻破，618 年亞歷山大在一年圍城之後因有人告知一條未設防的水道而失守。626 年波斯與阿瓦爾人、斯拉夫人聯手攻君士坦丁堡，在對岸的卡爾刻冬立營圍城一個月，8 月 7 日企圖用木筏渡過博斯普魯斯運兵的船隊被拜占庭水師殲滅，海牆一線的攻勢才告失敗。希拉克略的戰術轉變才是這場戰爭的骨幹：他放棄死守防線，改為主動反擊加季節性游擊加外交分化，622 至 628 年在亞美尼亞、高加索與米底亞之間反覆遠征，每到冬季就主動退回去，其目的不是攻城，而是讓波斯無法從邊防抽兵回援；同時拉攏亞美尼亞叛軍與突厥人，把戰線拉寬。627 年 12 月 12 日的尼尼微之戰是他的樣本：開戰當天有濃霧，弓騎的優勢被壓低，他佯退把波斯軍引到平原上，再突然回身進攻，精騎在追擊中襲擊波斯側翼，一打就是八個時辰，波斯軍退向丘陵而未全線崩潰；拉赫扎德陣亡，希拉克略自己也唇部受傷。次年他進軍到泰西封門外，卻因奈赫拉萬運河的橋樑倒塌而無法越過，只好在 1 月 6 日發出最後通牒，等波斯宮廷自己先垮。
tacticsEn: The Sasanian method was that of a frontier war: advance on two axes, along the east bank of the Euphrates and across the Armenian highlands; let the mounted archers saturate the ground with arrows from the composite reflex bows first, then send the heavy cavalry forward with their long lances; and rather than risk a single decisive battle, take the Roman frontier cities one at a time and cut the lines between them. Dara, Edessa, Amida, Antioch and Jerusalem all fell in this way. Besieges were pressed with counterweight trebuchets and with earthworks brought up to the walls; Jerusalem was stormed in 614, and Alexandria collapsed in 618 after a year under siege when a man revealed an undefended canal. The attack on Constantinople in 626, mounted with the Avars and Slavs, was based at Chalcedon on the far shore of the strait and lasted a month, and it collapsed on 7 August when the Persian raft fleet trying to carry troops across the Bosporus was destroyed by the Byzantine ships and the assault on the sea wall failed. The tactical turn in the war was Heraclius's own. He gave up the static frontier and adopted active counter-attack, seasonal raiding and diplomatic division all at once, campaigning repeatedly between Armenia, the Caucasus and Media from 622 to 628 and breaking off before each winter. The purpose was not to take cities but to prevent Persia from pulling troops off the frontier to reinforce the heartland; at the same time he brought the Armenian rebels and the Turks into the war and widened the theatre. The battle of Nineveh on 12 December 627 is the model of this: thick fog on the morning of the battle cut down the advantage of the Persian mounted archers; Heraclius feigned a retreat to draw the Persian army onto the plain, then turned and attacked, his elite cavalry striking the pursuing Persian flank, and the fighting went on for eight hours before the Persian army withdrew to the hills without a complete rout. Rhahzadh was killed and Heraclius himself was wounded in the lip. The next year he reached the gates of Ctesiphon but could not cross the Nahrawan canal because the bridge over it had collapsed, so on 6 January he issued his ultimatum and waited for the Persian court to collapse on its own.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。這場戰爭自 602 年打到 628 年，歷時二十六年，是羅馬—波斯戰爭系列中最長的一場。619 年前線的失陷有明確時序：609 年取馬爾丁與阿米達，605 年取達拉，610 年埃德薩陷落，613 年安提阿失守，614 年耶路撒冷在約三週圍城後被攻破，真十字架與其他聖物被運往泰西封，617 年卡爾刻冬陷落，618 年亞歷山大陷落，620 或 622 年安卡拉與羅德島等愛琴海島嶼落入波斯手中，626 年波斯與阿瓦爾聯軍兵臨君士坦丁堡城下，627 年 12 月 12 日尼尼微之戰，628 年達斯塔吉爾德被希拉克略軍劫掠並追回三百面羅馬軍旗，同年卡瓦德二世弒父即位求和，630 年 3 月 21 日真十字架送回耶路撒冷，629 年 9 月 14 日另有聖海綿歸位的典禮。兵力方面，626 年守城者約一萬二千名拜占庭精騎，對面是約八萬阿瓦爾與斯拉夫人；希拉克略 627 至 628 年的遠征軍編制為二萬五千至五萬名拜占庭部隊，另有四萬名突厥兵，進入冬季即因不耐嚴寒與襲擾而散失；甘札卡一役他面對的是約四萬人的波斯軍；尼尼微之戰打了八個時辰，編年史記波斯陣亡約六千人。行程上，從君士坦丁堡到尼尼微的直線距離約一千三百公里，希拉克略經亞美尼亞與高加索北上的迂迴路線單程超過一千五百公里。戰後的和約內容包括歸還 602 年以後所失的全部領土、歸還被俘官兵、支付賠償，以及歸還 614 年帶走的聖物。關於全戰死傷，後世編年史把雙方的總數記為二十萬以上，但沒有可靠的分項記錄。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war lasted from 602 to 628, twenty-six years, the longest of the Roman-Persian wars. The sequence of losses on the Byzantine side is datable: Mardin and Amida in 609, Dara in 605, Edessa in 610, Antioch in 613, Jerusalem broken after a siege of about three weeks in 614 with the True Cross and other relics carried off to Ctesiphon, Chalcedon in 617, Alexandria in 618, Ancyra together with Rhodes and other Aegean islands in 620 or 622, the Persian-Avar armies before Constantinople in 626, the battle of Nineveh on 12 December 627, the plundering of Dastagird in 628 with three hundred captured Byzantine standards recovered, the murder of Khosrow and the peace offer in 628, the ceremonial return of the Holy Sponge on 14 September 629 and the delivery of the True Cross to Jerusalem on 21 March 630. On strength: the defenders of Constantinople in 626 counted about 12,000 trained Byzantine cavalry against roughly 80,000 Avars and Slavs; the army with which Heraclius invaded in 627 and 628 is given as between 25,000 and 50,000 Byzantine troops, with 40,000 Turks who melted away as soon as the winter closed in and they could not stand the cold and the harassment; at Ganzaka he faced a Persian army of some 40,000; the battle of Nineveh lasted eight hours and the chronicles put the Persian dead at about 6,000. On distance, the straight line from Constantinople to Nineveh is roughly 1,300 kilometres, and the northern route Heraclius took through Armenia and the Caucasus exceeded 1,500 kilometres in one direction. The settlement of 630 provided for the return of all territories lost after 602, the return of captured soldiers, the payment of an indemnity, and the restoration of the relics taken in 614. As for the dead of the whole war, later chronicles put the total on both sides above 200,000, but there is no reliable breakdown.
cause: 戰爭的直接起因是拜占庭的宮廷政變。591 年，莫里斯扶植被廢的霍斯勞二世重登王位，換來波斯割讓上美索不達米亞、波斯亞美尼亞與高加索伊比利亞的部分土地，也換來帝國不必再向薩珊納貢。602 年，莫里斯在巴爾幹前線的兵變中被殺，福卡斯即位後殺死莫里斯的兒子、屠殺首都居民，薩珊朝廷則收留了莫里斯的一位王子並以此大做文章。霍斯勞二世宣布開戰，表面理由是為朋友與岳父復仇，實際上是要撕毀 591 年的條約、收回割地、恢復對幼發拉底河東岸與亞美尼亞的控制，並藉此把薩珊的勢力重新推向小亞細亞。拜占庭方面的挑釁同樣實在：福卡斯的屠殺政策招來境內猶太社群的敵意與叛亂，611 至 613 年巴勒斯坦的猶太起義者正是在波斯支持下攻擊基督教城鎮；609 年前後，薩珊還在帝國的邊境省與高加索扶植反對福卡斯的勢力，把上美索不達米亞的主教納爾西斯推向波斯一方。深層的原因則是兩國在近東的結構性競爭：薩珊要的是通往高加索與印度、以及地中海絲路的控制權與相關稅收，拜占庭要的是邊防與糧產；而 591 年之後的和平從未被雙方真正接受，邊境上的日常劫掠與越境叛逃一直沒有停過。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the war was a palace revolution in Byzantium. In 591 Maurice had set the deposed Khosrow II back on his throne in exchange for the cession of parts of Upper Mesopotamia, Persian Armenia and Caucasian Iberia, and in exchange for an end to the Sasanian tribute. In 602 Maurice was killed in a mutiny on the Balkan front; Phocas took over, murdered Maurice's sons and butchered the population of the capital, while the Sasanian court sheltered one of Maurice's sons and made much of it. Khosrow II declared war with the stated reason of avenging his friend and father-in-law, but the real purpose was to void the treaty of 591, to recover the ceded lands, to reassert control of the east bank of the Euphrates and of Armenia, and to push Sasanian power back into Asia Minor. The Byzantine provocation was equally concrete: Phocas's butcheries turned the empire's Jewish communities against him, and the Jewish rising in Palestine from 611 to 613 was carried out with Persian support against Christian towns; around 609 the Sasanians were fostering anti-Phocan elements in the frontier provinces and in the Caucasus and pushing Narses, the bishop of the Euphrates frontier, into Persian arms. Beneath the pretexts lay the structural rivalry of the two powers over the Near East: Persia wanted control of the routes to the Caucasus, to India and to the Mediterranean silk trade, and the taxes that went with it; Byzantium wanted its frontier and its grain; and the peace of 591 had never truly been accepted by either side, since raids across the frontier and defections over it never stopped.
impact: 這場戰爭的短期後果是兩個帝國都換了主人。拜占庭方面，希拉克略以單槍匹馬扭轉乾坤，被當時與後世描繪成受神眷顧的救主；626 年圍城之後出現的《阿卡提斯特聖歌》把守城的轉危為安歸於聖母護佑，希拉克略本人則是第一位護送真十字架回到耶路撒冷的皇帝，這一事件在編年史與禮儀中被放大成新時代的開端。薩珊方面代價更重：霍斯勞二世被自己兒子推翻，628 至 632 年之間卡瓦德二世、阿拉沙三世、沙赫巴拉茲以及兩位公主先後爭位，內戰消耗了剛被打殘的貴族與軍隊；西部的猶太社群與埃及的科普特社群在戰爭中看見帝國的軟弱，薩珊對高加索與中亞的權力也隨之鬆動。長期看，這是一場把兩大帝國都推到枯竭邊緣的戰爭：拜占庭雖然守住了疆域，卻失去了埃及與敘利亞的財富與糧食，也失去了過去獨佔的絲路與關稅；薩珊在 632 年之後迅速崩潰。630 年代興起的哈里發國家正是在這片真空裡迅速擴張，先取兩河流域、敘利亞與埃及，再取波斯。與此同時，戰爭也改造了拜占庭本身：主題軍制在安納托利亞、亞美尼亞與色雷斯重新編組，海軍與火油武器得到重視，希拉克略的東征則開啟了七世紀上半葉拜占庭與西歐重新接觸的局面。
impactEn: In the short run the war changed masters on both sides. For Byzantium, Heraclius had turned the tide by personal effort and was portrayed in his own day and afterwards as a deliverer under divine protection; the Akathist Hymn, composed after the siege of 626, attributed the city's survival to the Virgin's guardianship, and Heraclius became the first emperor to carry the True Cross back to Jerusalem, an event magnified by the chroniclers and the liturgy into the opening of a new age. The Sasanian cost was heavier: Khosrow II was overthrown by his own son, and between 628 and 632 Kavad II, Ardashir III, Shahrbaraz and two of Khosrow's daughters contested the throne in turn, a civil war that drained the aristocracy and the armies just broken on the field; in the west the Jewish communities of Palestine and the Coptic communities of Egypt had seen the empire's weakness at first hand, and Sasanian authority over the Caucasus and Central Asia loosened. In the long run this was a war that pushed both empires to exhaustion: Byzantium saved its territory but lost the wealth and the grain of Egypt and Syria along with its former monopoly of the silk road and its customs; the Sasanian state collapsed soon after 632. The caliphal state that rose in the 630s expanded into exactly this vacuum, taking Mesopotamia, Syria and Egypt first and Persia after that. At the same time the war reshaped Byzantium itself: the theme system was reorganised in Anatolia, Armenia and Thrace, the fleet and its fire weapons gained a new importance, and Heraclius's eastern campaigns opened the way to the renewed contact between Byzantium and the Latin West in the first half of the seventh century.
result: 結局分戰場與外交兩層。戰場上，627 年 12 月 12 日尼尼微之戰重創波斯主力，亞美尼亞裔將領拉赫扎德陣亡；628 年希拉克略的遠征軍掃過達斯塔吉爾德，繳獲財貨並追回三百面被擄的羅馬軍旗；628 年初薩珊宮廷政變，霍斯勞二世被囚五日後慢慢射死；卡瓦德二世即位即遣使求和，雙方在 630 年前後議和。外交上，和約的內容對拜占庭相當有利：歸還 602 年以後失去的全部領土，包括上美索不達米亞、亞美尼亞與高加索伊比利亞；歸還被俘的拜占庭官兵；由薩珊支付戰爭賠償；以及歸還 614 年自耶路撒冷掠去的真十字架與其他聖物，629 年 9 月 14 日聖海綿先行歸位，630 年 3 月 21 日真十字架送抵耶路撒冷，629 年希拉克略凱旋回君士坦丁堡。沒有人達成原來的目標：薩珊沒有踏過博斯普魯斯海峽，拜占庭也沒有拿下泰西封，邊界大致回到 591 年的狀態。希拉克略的勝利一半來自尼尼微的戰場，一半來自波斯宮廷內部的政變與沙赫巴拉茲被自己人刺殺；希拉克略本人也清楚這一點，所以並沒有提出苛刻的條件。但二十六年的消耗無法靠和約填補：薩珊在 632 年後走向崩潰，拜占庭在 630 年代面對阿拉伯軍時同樣精疲力竭，兩大帝國的「最後一場大戰」，最終為第三個帝國騰出了整個近東。
resultEn: The outcome has two layers, the field and the diplomat's table. On the field, the battle of Nineveh on 12 December 627 shattered the main Persian force and killed the Armenian-born general Rhahzadh; in 628 Heraclius's expedition swept through Dastagird, carrying off treasure and recovering three hundred captured Roman standards; early in 628 the Persian court revolted and Khosrow II was shut up in a dungeon and shot to death after five days; Kavad II sent envoys to sue for peace as soon as he was raised to the throne, and the two empires made their settlement around 630. On the diplomatic level the terms were distinctly favourable to Byzantium: the return of all territories lost after 602, including Upper Mesopotamia, Armenia and Caucasian Iberia; the return of captured Byzantine soldiers; war indemnity paid by the Sasanians; and the return of the True Cross and the other relics taken from Jerusalem in 614, with the Holy Sponge restored on 14 September 629 and the True Cross delivered to Jerusalem on 21 March 630, after Heraclius's triumphal entry into Constantinople in 629. Neither side achieved what it had originally wanted: the Persians never crossed the Bosporus, the Byzantines never took Ctesiphon, and the frontier broadly returned to its state of 591. Heraclius's victory was half earned at Nineveh and half purchased from the revolts inside the Persian court and the killing of Shahrbaraz by his own men; Heraclius knew this well and did not press harsh terms. But twenty-six years of consumption could not be filled in by a treaty: the Sasanian state slid towards collapse after 632, and the Byzantine Empire was just as exhausted when the Arab armies came in the 630s. The last great war of antiquity between the two empires cleared the entire Near East for a third.
